description: A packaged WinUI 3 build reports that an app host executable cannot be ProcessorArchitecture neutral, based on https://stackoverflow.com/questions/72980822/how-to-fix-a-packaged-winui3-app-build-what-makes-trouble-with-processorarchite.
prompt: Our packaged WinUI 3 build fails in CI with `Packaged .NET applications with an app host exe cannot be ProcessorArchitecture neutral. Please specify a RuntimeIdentifier or a Platform other than AnyCPU.` The project has x86/x64/arm64 in the csproj, but the pipeline still trips over Any CPU.
